seo.title: About Flowtali
seo.description: Flowtali is a document tool built for freelancers and small teams. Create professional invoices and letterheads with real-time preview and one-click PDF export.

heroSubtitle: Flowtali was built for freelancers and small teams who care about first impressions — because a polished invoice or letterhead says everything before you say a word.
missionP1: Too many great freelancers were sending invoices assembled in Google Docs, or letterheads cobbled together in Word — and it showed. Clients noticed. Deals were harder to close.
missionP2: We built Flowtali to close that gap. Professional-grade invoice and letterhead tooling, accessible to a solo designer, a consultant, or a 5-person studio — not just the enterprise with a design team.
missionP3a: Every template, every setting, every feature was designed with one question in mind:
missionP3b: If the answer is yes, it ships. If not, it doesn't.

values.title: What you see is what they get
values.desc: Live preview is at the heart of Flowtali. No surprises after export — your document looks exactly the same on screen as it does printed.

values.title: Speed without compromise
values.desc: A first draft in under two minutes. No fiddling with margins or table formatting. Just fill, preview, share.

values.title: Your data stays yours
values.desc: We don't read your documents, sell your data, or share it with third parties. Encrypted in transit, access-controlled by you.

ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of freelancers and small businesses sending better documents.
